academic#library-of-pergamum.p: Pergamum was home to a library said to house approximately 200,000 volumes, according to the writings of Plutarch.

academic#plato-s-academy.p: The Academy was founded by Plato in ca. 385 BC in Athens. It persisted throughout the Hellenistic period as a sceptical school. The site was located near Colonus, 6 stadia (1 mile) from the Dipylon gates.

core_building#governor-s-palace.p: The Governor's Palace is an important centre of political power, and a deliberately impressive symbol of Roman might and authority.

core_building#pro-consul-s-palace.p: The Pro-Consul's Palace is an unmissable symbol of Roman might and authority. Those who live in its shadow can have no doubts as to who is in charge.

core_building#imperial-palace.p: The Curia is the ultimate expression in marble and stone of Roman authority.

defenses#small-stone-wall.p: A rough wooden wall is a better defence than a crude palisade, but it is not likely to present much of a problem to attackers.

defenses#stone-wall.p: Stone walls are fairly substantial and give a degree of security to a town, but truly determined attackers will be able to breach them.

defenses#large-stone-wall.p: Large walls are substantial, and even organised enemies will have a hard time scaling them or breaking into the city.

defenses#epic-stone-wall.p: These awesome walls will present all attackers with an apparently impregnable barrier when assaulting a protected city.

despotic_law#secret-police-hq.p: The Secret Police make sure that foolish and rebellious people simply disappear. Peace and tranquility are maintained.

despotic_law#secret-police-network.p: Better even than the Secret Police are a network of informers. When anyone may be listening, the disloyal and rebellious tongue remains still.

dyes_production#dye-exports-urban.p: A grand centre of dye exports, crafting refined hues for those with taste, and wealth, to match.

food_storage#grain-export-port-food-trad.p: This region is exporting enormous amounts of grain, enough for a massive city or for several smaller ones.

glass_production#fine-glassware-artisans.p: Fine glassware is now exported far and wide, turning fragile beauty into hard profit.

governmentc.p: A single-level building: there is nothing to upgrade it into.

governmentc#direct-rule.p: Our state has chosen to exert its control over this region, not trusting the local people to properly act in our interest we have set our own officials in charge of administration, taxation and all matters of governance.

governmentd.p: A single-level building: there is nothing to upgrade it into.

governmentd#homeland.p: Our sacred homeland! Our gods live here and by their will we sprung from this soil and we will return to the soil when we die.

health#public-baths-sanitation.p: Public baths play an important part in the social life of the town; they are a place to meet as much as somewhere to get clean. They are also a sign of 'Roman-ness'.

health#aqueduct-sanitation.p: What have the Romans ever done for us? This, that's what.

health#great-bathhouse-sanitation.p: A huge bathhouse that forms a linchpin of Roman civilization.

hemp_cultivation#cordage-exports-rural.p: The ropes and sails made here now tie together our fleet and so help tie our empire together.

ivory_trade#ivory-trader-rural.p: A trading house of rare wonders, where ivory is weighed by tusk, price, and ego alike.

The height of Rome’s military power, producing elite troops and war machines to uphold the Republic’s honour and might.
